fusions.name: Poleaxed
fusions.desc: A chopping downward swing of your horns that deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.4 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slaughterman's Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps your horns in a full circle, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and making them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Long Backswing
fusions.desc: After a 0.5-second wind-up, increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Standing Over the Fallen
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a shield worth 15% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
